top_signals.summary: Kyiv’s drones target Ozon warehouses after weeks of strikes against market leader Wildberries

top_signals.title: US Set to Unveil Fresh Iran Sanctions | The Pulse 8/24/2026
top_signals.summary:
"The Pulse With Francine Lacqua" is all about conversations with high profile guests in the beating heart of global business, economics, finance and politics. Based in London, we go wherever the story is, bringing you exclusive interviews and market-moving scoops.

Today's guests: 
Isabelle Mateos y Lago, BNP Paribas, Group Chief Economist; Orysia Lutsevych, Chatham House, Russia and Eurasia Programme Deputy Director; Sven Kruck, Quantum Systems, Co-CEO.  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Yields decline on CNBC report Treasury could use General Account to fund buybacks
top_signals.summary: Treasury yields fell Monday as investors await Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh's keynote speech at Jackson Hole later this week.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Total CEO Says Market Is Bearish for Crude, Bullish for Products
top_signals.summary: The global oil market has diverged fundamentally, with a bearish outlook for crude but bullish prices for products, said TotalEnergies SE Chief Executive Officer Patrick Pouyanne.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Moody’s Upgrades Pakistan on Improving Economic Outlook
top_signals.summary: Moody’s Ratings upgraded Pakistan’s sovereign credit rating, citing a stronger external position, better fiscal metrics and lower domestic financing costs, extending a recovery in the South Asian nation’s credit profile.
